items.q: you wouldn't have Buddy Tate and say, Ben Webster together?

ctx.x: I couldn't very well hold on to sound as well because Lester's sound was a different thing, you know, but I mean I would say the same formula I leaned pretty heavy on it, like the tenor.
I mean so you wouldn't have -- in other words, you wouldn't have Buddy Tate and say, Ben Webster together?
